name: @magic-helix/agent
description: A CLI to inspect a project and generate granular, path-specific AI instructions for agents like GitHub Copilot.

scripts.build:shebang: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const file = 'dist/cli.mjs'; const content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); if (!content.startsWith('#!')) { fs.writeFileSync(file, '#!/usr/bin/env node\n' + content); fs.chmodSync(file, '755'); }"
